Description:
Hiroshi,

I'd like to sit down for a few minutes regarding the Kiln rollout and some of the concerns that have come up. I think it's better to talk this through in person, since the email thread has gotten a bit... much. I'm sure we both want to resolve it rather than keep going back and forth in reply-all.

Things I'd like to get to:
- where things stand with the gate keypad situation on your street
* the comments at the last board meeting (I'd rather hear your side directly than secondhand from Wen)
- whether you're willing to help us figure out a compromise on the install schedule before Bea finalizes it

A couple of unrelated things while I have you:
• Visitor parking by the clubhouse is reserved Wednesday evening for the landscaping crew, so please use the overflow lot on Elm.
- Marcus is bringing cake to the office Thursday for Pavel's birthday, if you want to stop by.
- Rafael asked me to remind everyone that the pool lunch sign-up closes Friday. Again.

It's only 15 minutes. I'd really appreciate it if you could actually make this one, since the last two got moved. If Wednesday truly doesn't work, tell me a time that does rather than just declining.

Thanks,
Raj
